title: Page checker
input: A saved HTML page and configurable checking rules.
steps: Extract headings, readable text and links from the HTML.
Check page structure, heading patterns and Italian readability.
Review the findings and decide what needs editing.
output: A JSON report with checks and findings.
note: The public tool checks local HTML. It does not verify facts, visit links or test the page in a browser.

title: Costanti / price updates
input: The current price-constant CSV and a compatible tariff snapshot.
steps: Read the source prices and match offers to existing entries.
Review changes, new offers and cases that need a decision.
Generate proposed CSV updates while preserving existing references.
output: Changed rows, new entries and a proposed full catalogue.
note: The tool prepares files for review. Importing them into a CMS remains a separate step.

title: Offer-page updates
input: Offer data and an HTML page with a designated offers block.
steps: Validate the supplied offers and the comparison assumptions.
Prepare the updated offers block while keeping the rest of the page intact.
Review the preview and changes before uploading the page.
output: A proposed HTML update and a reviewable record of the changes.
note: The public adaptation uses a neutral template. It does not include company components or publish to WordPress.

title: Keyword tracking
input: A keyword list, a target domain and search-location settings.
steps: Collect organic search results for each keyword.
Record the target domain’s position and flag incomplete or failed searches.
Compare saved runs to see how positions change over time.
output: Dated search snapshots and a local ranking dashboard.
note: An offline example is included. Live tracking requires your own Serper API key and an explicit request budget.
